# FlowBuild AI

> FlowBuild AI is a done-for-you sales system and appointment-setting agency in Ireland, run by co-founders Liam Kieran and Paddy Meade. For businesses selling €5,000+ contracts, it runs Meta ads, replies to every enquiry instantly, calls to qualify each lead and books sales calls into the client's calendar ("The 90-Day Done-For-You Sales System"). Each client's lowest forecast is guaranteed in writing. FlowBuild AI also designs custom websites for Irish businesses.

- Phone and WhatsApp: 085 876 4679 (+353 85 876 4679)
- Address: Enniskeen, Kingscourt, Co. Cavan, A82 RY70, Ireland
- Hours: open 24 hours
- Email: info@flowbuildai.ie
- Area served: all of Ireland
- Google Business Profile: https://maps.google.com/?cid=15357603946865523882
- Customers: local and B2B businesses, including architects, trades, barbershops, gyms, clinics, renovation companies, professional services and solar installers
- Way of working: done for you; the client owns what is built; no lock-in contract
- Client rating: 5-star average; 100% of clients satisfied
